title: Merge drawing: boolean path operations
description: Implement Flash's merge-drawing model in packages/core/src/engine/: path intersection detection (line-line, line-curve, curve-curve), polygon union for same-color fills, subtraction (different color top shape cuts away bottom), and stroke segment splitting. Entry point: mergeDraw(existingShapes: Shape[], newShape: Shape): Shape[] — returns the resulting merged shapes. Purely packages/core/src/engine/. See docs/03-drawing-vector-graphics.md.
